title: Model an IS Student Enrollment Class
prompt: Create a class Student with __init__(self, name, credits=0), a method add_credits(self, n) that increases self.credits by n, and __repr__ returning f'Student({self.name}, {self.credits})'.
hints: Store self.name = name and self.credits = credits in __init__.
explanation: __init__ initializes instance state, methods mutate self, and __repr__ formats the object.
visibleTests:
s = Student('Ana', 12)
s.add_credits(3)
assert s.credits == 15
assert repr(s) == 'Student(Ana, 15)'

title: Fix Missing self Parameter
prompt: Calling inv.value() raises a TypeError because self is missing from the method signature. Fix the Product class.
hints: Add self as the first parameter of value(self).
explanation: Instance methods always receive the instance as their first argument (self).
bugDescription: value() was missing the self parameter.

title: Predict @dataclass Equality
prompt: Type the exact output printed when comparing two @dataclass instances.
explanation: @dataclass compares fields by value in __eq__ rather than object identity.

title: Role of self
prompt: Recall what self represents in a method.
solution: A reference to the current instance of the class.
front: What does `self` refer to inside a Python class method?
back: The specific object instance on which the method was called (similar to `this` in Java/JS).
